name: @gizmos-quest/audacity-mcp

tools.name: audacity_launch
tools.description: Start or attach to Audacity with a visible or hidden Windows project window. Waits for a real script-pipe response.

tools.name: audacity_window
tools.description: Show or hide the Audacity window on Windows. A hidden Audacity keeps working through the pipe.

tools.name: audacity_quit
tools.description: On Windows, quit Audacity without a save prompt. Without saveTo the project is discarded (saved to a temporary file that is then deleted).

saveTo.description: keep the project at this .aup3 path

tools.name: audacity_dialogs
tools.description: On Windows, list Audacity's open windows and dialogs; close=true closes the dialogs (WM_CLOSE, like the window's X; Cancel for questions). Use it when a call times out: a modal dialog blocks the pipe.

tools.name: audacity_fresh
tools.description: Get an empty project in a single window. A running session is backed up when it has tracks (backupTo required), then restarted, even when empty. Restart is Windows-only; on other platforms save and quit Audacity first. Never use the New menu: a second project window has crashed Audacity 3.7 under scripting.

tools.name: audacity_status
tools.description: Whether Audacity answers, and its tracks with name, kind, start/end, volume, pan, mute and solo.

tools.name: audacity_info
tools.description: Read native state: Tracks, Clips, Envelopes (points as t/y), Labels, Boxes, Selection, Preferences, Commands (full catalogue with parameters) or Menus.

tools.name: audacity_describe
tools.description: Parameters of one scripting command or effect from the bundled English Audacity 3.7.8 catalogue.

tools.name: audacity_command
tools.description: Run a catalogue scripting command or effect on the current selection (Amplify, Compressor, Limiter, LoudnessNormalization, Normalize, High-passFilter, FilterCurve, AutoDuck, FadeIn, …). Parameters follow Audacity's own list; see audacity_describe. Native Set* setters use selected tracks: call audacity_select first. NoiseReduction requires a captured profile.

tools.name: audacity_menu
tools.description: Run a menu command that needs no dialog (Play, Stop, Undo, Redo, SelectAll, SelectNone, NewMonoTrack, NewStereoTrack, NewLabelTrack, AddLabel, ZoomSel, FitInWindow, CursProjectStart, …). Use audacity_transport for guarded recording.

tools.name: audacity_select
tools.description: Select a time range on one or more tracks (all tracks when track is omitted; the whole project when start/end are omitted).

track.description: track index (0-based) or unique track name

tools.name: audacity_import
tools.description: Import an audio (or video, for its sound) file as a new track, name it and place it at start seconds.

tools.name: audacity_track_set
tools.description: Set track properties: name, gain in dB (the track's volume slider; status reports it back as a linear factor), pan (-1..1), mute, solo.

track.description: track index (0-based) or unique track name

pan.description: normalized pan: -1 full left, 0 center, 1 full right

tools.name: audacity_clip_move
tools.description: Move the clip that covers time `at` on a track so it starts at `start` seconds.

track.description: track index (0-based) or unique track name

tools.name: audacity_envelope_set
tools.description: Write a volume envelope on a track: points of time (s) and linear gain (1 = unchanged, 0.5 = -6 dB, 0.25 = -12 dB). Visible as the volume curve in Audacity. replace=true clears the old points first.

track.description: track index (0-based) or unique track name

tools.name: audacity_labels_set
tools.description: Add point or region labels to a named label track, creating it if needed and retaining existing labels. Use them for chapters, picture events or script lines. Disable the label naming dialog in Preferences > Tracks > Track Behaviors before adding labels.

tools.name: audacity_effect
tools.description: Select a track/range and apply an effect using the bundled English Audacity 3.7.8 catalogue parameters. Default time scope is the track extent, avoiding silent gap clips. NoiseReduction requires a captured profile on this same track and params={}; it uses saved UI settings. Scripted effects add no undo entry: save a project backup first.

track.description: track index (0-based) or unique track name

tools.name: audacity_noise_profile
tools.description: Capture room tone in a fresh Audacity process, then apply NoiseReduction with params={}. Audacity 3.7.8 uses saved UI settings, ignores effect parameters and cannot reset its profile through scripting. Repeating this exact interval reuses its profile; a different interval requires audacity_fresh with backupTo.

track.description: track index (0-based) or unique track name

tools.name: audacity_export
tools.description: Export the rendered mix or an explicit time range to WAV/FLAC/MP3/OGG by file extension, honoring gain, pan, mute, solo and envelopes. Selects time and tracks explicitly, including after label editing; channels is 1 or 2.

tools.name: audacity_project
tools.description: Open an existing .aup3 into an empty project or save to a new .aup3 path. Existing save destinations are refused to prevent a blocking modal. Use audacity_fresh with backupTo before opening when tracks are present.

tools.name: audacity_pipeline
tools.description: Preview or run a reviewed cleanup/mastering chain on one track: voice, podcast, interview, audiobook, vocal, live, music, lo-fi or cleanup. dryRun lists exact ordered commands without changing selection. Noise reduction requires supplied room tone; normalization and limiting are explicit. Default range is the track extent, recalculated after edits.

noiseProfile.description: explicit room-tone interval; omitting it skips noise reduction

shortenPauses.description: optional destructive silence truncation; changes timing and video sync

removeClicks.description: must remain false: native Click Removal can open a blocking result dialog

loudness.description: normalization can raise quiet audio; select it explicitly

limitPeakDb.description: optional limiter after normalization; measure the result

tools.name: audacity_edit
tools.description: Split, split-new, trim, duplicate, delete, cut/copy, silence or join/disjoin audio on explicit tracks and time range. split accepts a cursor; delete closes the gap while split_delete retains timing. Paste is not offered: it depends on the system clipboard.

tools.name: audacity_generate
tools.description: Generate tone/noise/silence/chirp/rhythm in a new mono/stereo track, or replace a range of an existing track. Uses a time selection for duration and validates kind-specific parameters before adding tracks.

track.description: omit to create a new track; supplying it replaces audio in the range

channels.description: new-track channel count; defaults to mono and must be omitted for an existing track

tools.name: audacity_clip_set
tools.description: Rename/color a clip or apply a relative gain in dB destructively to its samples. For name/color, at must lie strictly inside exactly one clip, avoiding shared boundaries. Use audacity_track_set gainDb for a reversible track slider, audacity_clip_move for timing.

at.description: time inside the clip; name/color require a point strictly after its start and before its end

gainDb.description: relative sample gain applied destructively with Amplify to this clip

tools.name: audacity_track_edit
tools.description: Add mono/stereo/label tracks, remove tracks, mix/render, or align selected tracks by start/end/selection. Track scope is explicit; add actions can name the new track. mix_new keeps the original tracks audible: mute them before exporting the new mix to avoid doubling. Find the new audio track in returned tracks; it can precede label tracks.

tools.name: audacity_fade
tools.description: Apply sample FadeIn or FadeOut on one track and time range. Omitting time applies to the track extent; use envelope_set for editable automation.

tools.name: audacity_auto_duck
tools.description: Destructively duck bed samples under speech using native AutoDuck; save a project backup first. The unselected voice must be the immediately following track below the selected bed; import the bed first, then voice. dryRun lists exact parameters/range. Use audacity_envelope_set for editable ducking or an existing track order.

bed.description: bed track index (0-based) or unique name; must immediately precede the voice track

voice.description: voice track index (0-based) or unique name; must immediately follow the bed track

duckDb.description: attenuation applied to the bed, in dB

maximumPause.description: maximum pause to bridge while ducking, in seconds

tools.name: audacity_loudness_target
tools.description: Measure then apply static gain to approach targetLufs while preserving measured true-peak headroom and respecting maxBoostDb. Requires ffmpeg and a non-silent audio track; default scope is its own extent. dryRun returns the measured input and Amplify plan without applying gain. Reports before/after and whether the target was achievable; it never compresses or guesses absent LUFS/true peak.

truePeakCeilingDbtp.description: maximum rendered true peak, in dBTP

maxBoostDb.description: maximum positive static gain, in dB; does not cap attenuation

toleranceLu.description: allowed distance from targetLufs, in LU

tools.name: audacity_silence
tools.description: Find quiet regions without deleting audio: every channel must stay below thresholdDb for minimumSeconds. Scan an optional file, or rendered tracks/currentSelection with selection restored. Times are absolute project seconds for Audacity ranges and file seconds for files. Returns capped regions plus the total count; current mute/gain/envelopes affect rendered silence.

tools.name: audacity_probe_file
tools.description: Inspect an audio/video file before importing or exporting: container, duration, audio codecs, sample rate, channels and stream metadata. Requires optional ffprobe (installed with ffmpeg); reads the file without changing Audacity.

tools.name: audacity_measure
tools.description: Measure tracks, a time range, or currentSelection using a temporary export; restores selection and preserves track controls. Reports peak/RMS/DC/crest, advisory defects and silence. Optional ffmpeg adds integrated LUFS/LRA/true peak. Reads rendered gain/mute/solo/envelopes, so use file measurement for unprocessed source levels. With targets, returns {measurement,targetCheck}; otherwise returns the measurement directly.

tools.name: audacity_measure_file
tools.description: Measure an exported/source audio file without touching Audacity. Native PCM/float WAV peak/RMS/DC/crest and advisory defects need no dependencies; ffmpeg on PATH adds EBU R128 LUFS/LRA/true peak and decodes other containers. Unavailable targets report unknown. With targets, returns {measurement,targetCheck}; otherwise returns the measurement directly.

tools.name: audacity_compare_files
tools.description: Compare before/after audio files with the same measurement settings. Returns both reports and numeric changes only for metrics established on both sides; missing LUFS or true peak never becomes a zero change.

tools.name: audacity_targets
tools.description: List numeric house reference targets for podcast, video, broadcast, audiobook and premaster; use these with measurement targets. These references are not publishing certification. Recording noise floor requires isolated room tone.

tools.name: audacity_contrast
tools.description: Measure the RMS level difference between foreground speech and background room tone without opening Audacity Contrast. Each range is exported with current track controls and selection restored. This is a numeric contrast check, not full accessibility certification.

tools.name: audacity_transport
tools.description: Play a selected region, pause/resume, stop, or record using Audacity’s configured input. Appending requires an explicit audio track matching the configured recording channels (1 or 2). Record mode respects Audacity’s new-track preference, and recording always starts from a cursor point to avoid batch progress waits. status reports selection and a monotonic estimated position; manual transport changes are not tracked. record returns immediately unless duration is supplied.

tools.name: audacity_history
tools.description: Undo or redo existing native menu/import history entries. Individual scripted effects and pipelines add no undo entry; save a project backup before destructive processing. Stops before a step the native history does not have, or at Audacity’s own first error, and does not claim checkpoint rollback.

tools.name: audacity_project_info
tools.description: Read project tracks, clips, selection, length, active project paths and actual render sample rate. Rate is measured by a tiny temporary WAV export with selection restored; an empty project returns rate=null and its default preference separately.

tools.name: audacity_preferences
tools.description: Get a preference or list available preferences. Set is restricted to default project sample rate and recording channel count; never changes modules, UI language, devices or pipe settings. Original value and readback are returned.

tools.name: audacity_macros
tools.description: List or apply saved local Audacity macros without opening the Macro Manager. Every step is parsed and checked first; dryRun lists steps. Modal/lifecycle commands and implicit effect presets are refused. Export macros need explicit outputTo.

tools.name: audacity_recover
tools.description: Inspect process, pipe and crash-recovery entries; optionally close blocking dialogs and reconnect after a timeout. Never kills Audacity or replays edits. discardRecovery clears stale config entries only while Audacity is stopped, saving the config first and retaining all project files.

tools.name: audacity_labels
tools.description: List/find labels by text, edit one flat zero-based label index, delete one label, or create regular markers. Delete safely reconstructs only its label track at the bottom of the project, preserving every other label including overlaps; returned indices reflect the new order.

tools.name: audacity_labels_file
tools.description: Import Audacity TSV or JSON labels into a named track; export labels as TSV/JSON, SRT/VTT subtitles, timestamp chapters, CUE, Podlove or ffmetadata. Point-label subtitle ends come from the next marker or project end. Existing output files are refused.

tools.name: audacity_label_regions_export
tools.description: Export every positive-duration region in one label track as numbered audio files, using the current mix and explicit time/track selections. Point labels are skipped. Existing outputs are refused and all destinations are checked before export.

tools.name: audacity_batch
tools.description: Clean/master audio files in Audacity using isolated temporary tracks and the reviewed pipeline. Preflights all paths/steps, dryRun lists jobs, and original tracks stay intact. Pause shortening requires an empty project because sync-lock may shift other tracks. Stops at the first failure; completed outputs are retained. Optional before/after reports measure the rendered result. Current solo tracks are refused because they could silence temporary-track exports.

shortenPauses.description: optional destructive silence truncation; changes timing and video sync

removeClicks.description: must remain false: native Click Removal can open a blocking result dialog

loudness.description: normalization can raise quiet audio; select it explicitly

limitPeakDb.description: optional limiter after normalization; measure the result

instructions: Control one local English Audacity 3.7 session. Inspect status and describe effects before editing. Save a new project backup before destructive work; scripted effects have no per-call undo. Preview pipelines with dryRun. After an uncertain reply use dialogs and recover, inspect the project, and never replay an edit automatically.
